title: Hunt loot stored by Trade's receiver at First Step Memorial Station sold where it lies
note: 2026-11-22 07:37 UTC (Mercury): orders ENT-062, block MERCURY and P5: a sell route at a station where our hunts hand their loot to Trade's receiver (data/fleet/receivers.json; hunt routes with gift_to trader and sell_at here). With strict classes on the hunt gives every good into the receiver's storage here; this route withdraws what sells and sells it at the floors, then stores what the bids left. Evidence: hunts with sell_at here took 466 verdigris curd and sold 50 for 16,500 cr in 24 h (330 each), sold 23 noble condensate for 15,870; book 2026-11-22 07:33 UTC: no curd bid, noble 690 x 27, superfluid 600 x 50, ember 480 x 7 (the gate keeps the trip home while no curd bid stands). requires.stored sends only a pilot whose own storage here holds 30 verdigris_curd; requires.bid closes it while a book read within the hour shows no verdigris_curd bid at 300. Floors at or near the standing NPC bids, never under a standing bid (F12); goods without a bid above 25 cr (carapace, raw xeno meat, crystallized biogas, fusion pearl, levity bladder) stay stored. Nothing is bought. A test: one ship (F37: three results decide). 2026-11-22 07:40 UTC (Mercury): superfluid vial taken out of the sale: reservecheck.py holds it back for the recipe superfluid_winding (control_node); it stays stored with the receiver.
